note: a world light (with ambientIntensity) turned by a Transform above it, and a default (global FALSE) light that lights only its own group
scope: shadows and shadowIntensity are read and not used (no shadow generator is made)

ambientIntensity feeds Babylon's one scene ambient colour (the sum over the lights that are on, times material ambientIntensity * diffuseColor, compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 in the picture, mad 1.6); a light with global FALSE adds its ambient to every shape, not only its group
global FALSE lights the meshes below the parent group; meshes added later are picked up when the mesh count changes (checked in our body)
